quality.title: Specified, not approximated
quality.lede: We trade to defined grade, assay, particle size and packaging — with the paperwork to prove it.

hero.title: From landlocked mines to any port
hero.lede: ALTAN procures at the source in Central Asia and carries material out through multimodal corridors — rail, road and sea — on the incoterm you trade on.

corridor.title: One controlled, multimodal chain
corridor.lede: A landlocked origin means the route is the product. We plan each leg, bond the transit and hand over on your terms.

modes.title: Every leg, planned
modes.lede: Rail, road and sea combine into one accountable movement from source to destination.

i1.title: Rail
i1.body: Block trains and wagons move bulk material out of the region on scheduled paths.

i2.title: Road
i2.body: Bonded trucking bridges smelters, railheads and ports where rail does not reach.

i3.title: Sea
i3.body: Onward ocean freight via the Caspian, Black Sea and beyond to your destination port.

incoterms.title: We deliver on your terms
incoterms.lede: From ex-works pickup to delivered-duty-paid, we quote and ship on the incoterm that fits your operation.

EXW.desc: You collect at our named point; we prepare and document the lot.

FCA.desc: We hand over to your carrier at the agreed place, cleared for export.

FOB.desc: We load onto the vessel at the named port of shipment.

CFR.desc: We cover carriage to the destination port; risk passes on loading.

CIF.desc: As CFR, with marine insurance to the destination port.

DAP.desc: We deliver to your named place, ready for unloading.

DDP.desc: We deliver cleared and duties paid at your door.

hero.title: Every lot, documented and screened

assurance.title: Qualified before it ships

hero.title: A trading house built around the material
hero.lede: ALTAN links Central Asia's mines and smelters to industrial buyers worldwide — with mine-level access, independent qualification and a documented chain from source to settlement.

story.title: Close to the source, accountable to the buyer
story.p1: Central Asia holds some of the world's most important deposits of refractory and critical metals — but it is landlocked, and moving material to market takes more than a purchase order.
story.p2: ALTAN was built to close that gap. We buy at the mine and smelter gate, qualify each lot in independent laboratories, and carry it out through the rail, road and sea corridors that connect the region to global industry.
story.p3: The result is a single, auditable chain: buyers get material to specification, on their incoterm, with the certificates and screening that critical-material trade demands.

i1.title: Mine-level access
i1.body: We source at the origin, not through layers of intermediaries.

i2.title: Independent qualification
i2.body: Third-party assay before material enters the chain.

i3.title: Auditable chain
i3.body: Every price, change and handover is recorded and traceable.

i4.title: Compliance-first
i4.body: Sanctions and export-control screening precede every commitment.
